fields.description:
## Context / Problem

`compute_validity` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:689-715) has exactly two modes for a
plan-review attestation: a SCOPED record re-hashes its signed dependency map, and an UNSCOPED
record (empty `deps`) falls back to whole-HEAD freshness — `signed_head != head` ⇒
`stale-head`, i.e. ANY commit anywhere invalidates it. A ticket that genuinely touches no repo file
is unscoped-by-truth and therefore re-reviewed on every unrelated commit.

With the tri-state from S1 [rebar:1934-63dd-4be9-4c48] available, an attestation can record that its empty
dependency set is a DECLARED EMPTY SET rather than an unknown one, and skip the fallback.

## Approach

Add a third scope kind to the signed manifest. `dependency_hashes` already computes the path
set; a sibling function classifies the scope:

- non-empty deps → `paths` (unchanged);
- empty deps + the ticket's effective file-impact scope is `none` → `none`;
- empty deps otherwise → `unscoped` (unchanged).

`build_manifest` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/manifest.py:309) emits a `file-scope: none` line
ONLY for the `none` kind, so existing manifests are byte-identical for the other two kinds and
no already-signed attestation changes meaning. A `manifest_file_scope(manifest)` reader
mirrors the existing `manifest_deps` / `manifest_regver` accessors, and reads from the
AUTHENTICATED manifest only (ADR 0049) — the plaintext mirror is never consulted, so the line
cannot be forged onto a signed record.

`compute_validity`'s DEFAULT profile then reads: deps non-empty → re-hash as today; deps empty
AND `manifest_file_scope == "none"` → the code-freshness dimension does not apply, continue to
the material/phase/pin checks; deps empty otherwise → the existing whole-HEAD `stale-head`
check. Every other invalidation dimension is untouched.

The safety interlock is the material fingerprint: `material_fingerprint`
(src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py:552) gains `file_impact_scope` and `no_file_impact_reason` next to
the `file_impact` it already hashes. Flipping the declaration in either direction therefore
yields `stale-material` on the existing check — an author cannot silently convert a
path-scoped or unscoped attestation into an immune one after signing, and a re-review is
forced whenever the claim itself changes.

`resign.py`'s drift-refresh path recomputes the manifest through the same builder, so a
`file-scope: none` record re-signs as one; the explicit assertion is added as a test rather
than new branching.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/manifest.py` — the scope classifier, the `file-scope:` manifest
  line in `build_manifest`, and the `manifest_file_scope` reader.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py` — the DEFAULT-profile branch in `compute_validity`;
  export the reader alongside `manifest_deps` in the module's `__all__`.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py` — `material_fingerprint` covers the declaration.
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py` — re-export as needed by the existing pattern.

Out of scope: container inheritance (S3), the P9 lint (S3), the review criterion (S4).

## Testing

- `compute_validity` table test over the three scope kinds × (HEAD moved / HEAD unchanged):
  `paths` re-hashes, `none` stays certified across a moved HEAD, `unscoped` reports
  `stale-head` — the last of these pins that today's conservative behavior is preserved.
- A manifest without a `file-scope:` line (a legacy record) keeps whole-HEAD behavior.
- A tampered plaintext `file-scope: none` on a record whose SIGNED manifest lacks it does not
  suppress the `stale-head` verdict.
- `material_fingerprint` differs across undeclared / none / paths for otherwise identical
  ticket material, and a change to `no_file_impact_reason` alone also changes it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An attestation signed for a ticket whose file-impact scope is `none` remains `certified` after
      an unrelated commit moves HEAD (checked: `compute_validity` test asserting `valid` and
      verdict `certified`).
- [ ] An attestation for an UNDECLARED empty-impact ticket still returns verdict `stale-head`
      after HEAD moves (checked: same test table, unchanged expectation).
- [ ] `file-scope: none` appears in the signed manifest only for the `none` kind; manifests
      for `paths` and `unscoped` tickets are byte-identical to pre-change output (checked:
      golden manifest test).
- [ ] A `file-scope: none` line present only in a record's plaintext manifest, absent from the
      authenticated one, does not change validity (checked: tamper test).
- [ ] Flipping a ticket between `none` and `paths` after signing yields verdict
      `stale-material` (checked: `compute_validity` test).
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the full test suite pass.
fields.title: Attestation scoping: a declared-none file impact signs 'file-scope: none' and skips whole-HEAD drift
